title: Reasoning effort, not tool access, buys first-try reliability in agentic code generation: an observational study
abstract: arXiv:2607.02436v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic coding assistants are increasingly given extra capabilities, such as browser based testing tools and design oriented system prompts, on the assumption that more capability yields better software. This study tested that assumption directly. Ninety independent agent runs built the same application, a real time retrospective board, from one detailed specification, each scored on a fixed 14 criterion functional rubric (42 point maximum) and a visual quality review. The runs spanned several model generations, two agent harnesses, two reasoning effort levels, a testing tool, and two design oriented prompts. Capability tier dominated: frontier models clustered near the ceiling while a low cost local model fell to 24 to 37 points. A criterion level analysis revealed what run totals conceal. Container deployment was the dominant defect, failing first try in 44 percent of runs, with its failure rate shifting sharply across model

translated_title: 推理努力，而非工具访问权限，决定智能体代码生成的一次成功率：一项观察性研究
translated_abstract: 智能体编码助手正越来越多地被赋予额外能力，例如基于浏览器的测试工具和面向设计的系统提示词，其背后的假设是能力越多，软件质量就越好。本研究直接检验了这一假设。九十次独立的智能体运行基于同一份详细规范构建同一个应用程序——一个实时回顾看板，每次运行都按照固定的14项准则功能评分标准（满分42分）以及视觉质量评审进行评分。这些运行跨越了多个模型代际、两种智能体框架、两个推理努力水平、一个测试工具以及两个面向设计的提示词。研究结果显示能力层级占主导地位：前沿模型的成绩接近满分上限，而低成本本地模型仅得24至37分。准则层面的分析揭示了运行总分所掩盖的问题：容器化部署是最主要的缺陷，44%的运行首次尝试即告失败，且其失败率在不同模型间急剧变化
tldr: 通过对90次智能体代码生成运行的观察性研究发现，模型能力层级（尤其是推理努力）而非额外的工具访问权限才是决定首次尝试可靠性的主导因素，其中容器化部署是最主要的缺陷来源，44%的运行首次尝试即失败。
en_tdlr: An observational study of 90 agentic code generation runs finds that model capability tier—particularly reasoning effort, not tool access—dominates first-try reliability, with container deployment emerging as the dominant defect, failing on first attempt in 44% of runs.
